    },
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "support",

    },
    {
      "login": "dangervslash",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "commented 'Resolved' without context"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:3028428558",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Why is one of the native Windows CI jobs failing to compile while the other is not?",
      "quote": "Why is one of the native Windows jobs failing to compile: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/16027562790/job/45219347987?pr=32857#step:10:553, but not the other: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/16027562790/job/45219348012?pr=32857 ?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained a function signature in fuzzer code was changed incorrectly",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3028521384"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:3028521384",
      "status_by_quote": "because it's in the fuzzer code, I incorrectly changed one of the function signatures there."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3373538840",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Add keypath_only option to descriptorprocesspsbt RPC since it also performs signing.",
      "quote": "descriptorprocesspsbt also does signing, it won't be far fetched to allow this option in that RPC too.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added keypath_only to descriptorprocesspsbt",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:4752463841",
      "status_by_quote": "Addressed feedback from @rkrux."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3373545774",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Add keypath_only option to sendall RPC as well.",
      "quote": "FinishTransaction is updated in this PR to have this option. It's used by send and sendall, so it seems reasonable to have this option in sendall too.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added keypath_only to sendall",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3373918453",
        "rc:3381789546"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3381789546",
      "status_by_quote": "Done in 8d819f7d8e6e93b8132ae0e621ad39740a9493df."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3373579206",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Consider adding keypath_only to sendmany and sendtoaddress.",
      "quote": "Along similar lines, sendmany and sendtoaddress also have similar expectations as send, which includes signing.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer agreed with author that older RPCs can be left alone",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3373918453"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3373954862",
      "status_by_quote": "Seems fine to me to not update them in this PR, they don't use the common internal signing/processing functions as well."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3373884121",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Add a test case in wallet_musig.py exercising keypath_only during the MuSig flow.",
      "quote": "A new test case can be added there as well by not passing the nosign option and by instead passing this new option to not sign the script path.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author pushed test coverage and reviewer accepted the implementation",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3381777110"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3412921110",
      "status_by_quote": "Nice, the changes in the commit are cleaner than what I suggested."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4496732663",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Add a release note for the changes across multiple RPCs.",
      "quote": "I believe the changes in the multiple RPCs require a release note.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added a release note commit",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4720808476"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:4720808476",
      "status_by_quote": "@rkrux pushed a release note commit."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3442425436",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Is the PR description outdated regarding adding or removing taproot_scripts?",
      "quote": "The PR description is outdated?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author clarified PR description and added code comments",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3442775488",
        "c:4752463841"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:4752463841",
      "status_by_quote": "Clarified in PR description as well code comments that we don't _add_ new taproot_scripts. We also don't _remove_ exiting ones, but don't _sign_ them."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3442568953",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Use ExtendedPrivateKey classes from PR #35543 to generate test keys programmatically instead of hardcoded extended keys.",
      "quote": "If it gets merged before this PR (this one doesn't need to be dependent on it), it'd be really nice to use the ExtendedPrivate(|Public)Key class(es) from there so that we can have programmatic test cases generation",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author rebased after #35543 and used the generator in tests",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3442938741",
        "c:4833771331"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:4833771331",
      "status_by_quote": "Rebased after #35543 and took advantage of it in the test, see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32857#discussion_r3485600298."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3443033699",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Avoid confusing overlapping boolean arguments in walletprocesspsbt (sign and keypath_only) by either using an enum or requiring sign to be true when keypath_only is true.",
      "quote": "Having both sign and keypath_only booleans might be confusing for the end user as the latter is a form of former.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author preferred keeping RPC arguments consistent across methods",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3443061743"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3443061743",
      "status_by_quote": "I think it's better to keep similar RPC methods consistent, even if it's a bit awkward for one of them."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3803512951",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Note that keypath_only=true also prevents finalizing via existing script path signatures in the PSBT, returning complete=false.",
      "quote": "This return also blocks finalizing via script path with signatures already in the PSBT, not just signing new ones. With `keypath_only=true` and `finalize=true`, such a PSBT comes back `complete=false`.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author documented this behavior and added test coverage, explaining keypath_only acts as a privacy and safety feature",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3812950793"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3812950793",
      "status_by_quote": "Clarified the documentation and added test coverage. I see `keypath_only=true` as a privacy / safety feature, so this behavior seems correct, even if surprising."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3803512956",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Is it intentional that fundrawtransaction and walletcreatefundedpsbt accept keypath_only without effect?",
      "quote": "This list is shared with fundrawtransaction and walletcreatefundedpsbt, which never sign, so both now accept keypath_only with no effect (before, they rejected it). Intentional?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author added support to walletcreatefundedpsbt and made fundrawtransaction throw",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3812941346"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3812941346",
      "status_by_quote": "I ended up adding support to `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, rather than suppressing the argument. `fundrawtransaction` now throws if you set it"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:4449901463",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Seems like a useful feature to have, the example in the PR description is helpful for the motivation.",

      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []

      "areas": []

      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "tests"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added suggestions and questions raised by fanquake, rkrux, and jeanpablojp covering scope expansion to additional RPCs, test coverage, release notes, and PSBT finalization behavior. All items have been addressed or fixed in code.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "review of rebased PR and latest changes",
      "id": "c:6680401537"
    }
  ]
}

claims.status_by_quote: I think it's better to keep similar RPC methods consistent, even if it's a bit awkward for one of them.

claims.text: Note that keypath_only=true also prevents finalizing via existing script path signatures in the PSBT, returning complete=false.
claims.quote: This return also blocks finalizing via script path with signatures already in the PSBT, not just signing new ones. With `keypath_only=true` and `finalize=true`, such a PSBT comes back `complete=false`.
claims.status_note: author documented this behavior and added test coverage, explaining keypath_only acts as a privacy and safety feature
claims.status_by_quote: Clarified the documentation and added test coverage. I see `keypath_only=true` as a privacy / safety feature, so this behavior seems correct, even if surprising.

claims.text: Is it intentional that fundrawtransaction and walletcreatefundedpsbt accept keypath_only without effect?
claims.quote: This list is shared with fundrawtransaction and walletcreatefundedpsbt, which never sign, so both now accept keypath_only with no effect (before, they rejected it). Intentional?
claims.status_note: author added support to walletcreatefundedpsbt and made fundrawtransaction throw
claims.status_by_quote: I ended up adding support to `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, rather than suppressing the argument. `fundrawtransaction` now throws if you set it

support.reason: Seems like a useful feature to have, the example in the PR description is helpful for the motivation.

Ran the 3 tests this PR touches, all pass. Skipping the fallback script path in the normal flow makes sense. Key path signing still works with the tweak, and script path fields already in the PSBT are left untouched.
